dedupe_keys.name: who showed up register of the organizations around data center siting in virginia 2014 to 2026

description: The Virginia data-centre siting register records organisations and dated actions surrounding local decisions from December 2014 to a September 2026 evidence snapshot. Zenodo provides a public 223-row, 23-column CSV with README, codebook, conflict log and a manifest of source URLs under CC BY 4.0. The register includes opposition groups, firms, public bodies, petitions and government actions, with row-level source references and rules for coding positions and jurisdictions. It can support actor-based or institutional scenarios in which permitting, local participation and resource constraints affect data-centre siting. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this Virginia register. The provider records 221 live and two merged rows; not every row is an organisation. The separately deposited saved source pages require an access request and are not part of this open CSV. Collection is bounded by searched public routes and the stated snapshot date, not an exhaustive record of private negotiations. The CSV was not downloaded and individual claims were not rechecked.
